title: A Tail of Two Cats
start: Talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.

items.t: Cat, hellcat, wily cat, or kitten (if a kitten, advised to bring food for it)
Catspeak amulet (a cramulet cannot be used as a substitute, you can separate the catspeak amulet from the cramulet with the Interact dismantle option)
Logs (can be obtained south of Unferth's house)
Four potato seeds (can be obtained south-west of Unferth's house from Head Farmer Jones)
Vial of water (as it will dry up in the desert, it is recommended to take this after you are finished with that part of the quest.)
A vial is more reliable. There is a sink right where you need the vial of water.
White desert robe outfit, druid's robe outfit, or other white-coloured robes

recommended.t: An enchanted water tiara or waterskins or completion of Crocodile tears
Varrock Teleport or a combat bracelet
A pharaoh's sceptre, sceptre of the gods, or Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport for quick teleport to Sophanem.
A desert amulet 2 or a player-owned house in Pollnivneach also gives close access to a magic carpet.
Completion of Contact! also allows one-way travel across the bridge from Menaphos to Sophanem, which is only a short distance from the Menaphos lodestone.
Active lodestones or teleportation across the free-to-play map in order to find Bob the Cat.

rewards.t: 2 antique lamps, which grant 2,500 experience each in a skill above level 30
rewards.l: Antique lamp (A Tail of Two Cats)

rewards.t: Catspeak amulet (e), which allows you to locate Bob.
Doctor's hat or nurse hat (you can switch by destroying your hat and requesting a new one from the Apothecary)
You can talk to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum to receive 5 kudos.

steps.t: Equip your catspeak amulet, have your pet cat with you, and talk to Unferth. His house is in eastern Burthorpe, south of Dunstan and east of Tam McGrubor. [Chat: Accept]
Speak to Hild in the building north of the Heroes' Guild. She will enchant the catspeak amulet for 5 death runes.
p: The highlighted area indicates Bob's wander radius.

steps.t: Locate Bob the Cat using the catspeak amulet.

sub.t: Click on the whiskers until the arrow and the eyes glow white.
Run in the direction of the arrow, occasionally re-checking the amulet, until you find Bob.
The easiest way to find Bob is to keep hopping worlds in the Carwen Essencebinder Magical Runes Shop in Burthorpe.

steps.t: Ask Gertrude about Bob's parents in her house west of Varrock. [Chat: 4 Ask about Bob's parents.]

sub.t: If Rat Catchers hasn't been started. [Chat: 5 Ask about Bob's parents.]

p: Amulet of catspeak (e) interface. The picture shows Bob is south-east of the player's current location

steps.t: Speak to Reldo in the Varrock library. [Chat: 3 Ask about Robert the Strong.]
Go back and talk to Bob the cat again, in the same spot you found him.
Go to Sophanem and talk to the Sphinx. [Chat: 1 Ask the Sphinx for help. › 2 Skip the cutscene and view summary.]

sub.t: Talk to Raetul and buy a full desert robe set, if you don't have them already.

p: The Sphinx talking to Bob the cat in the desert
Odysseus fighting the Dragonkin, before being killed.
Robert continues to fight the Dragonkin after Odysseus dies.

steps.t: Return to Unferth's house in Burthorpe and do the following:

sub.t: Rake the patch behind his house and plant potato seeds in it. Your cat will notify you when they are done (typically 25–35 minutes to grow). A supreme growth potion from player-owned farm cannot be used to accelerate growth. It will not get disease, and it does not need composting or watering.
If you don't have your cat out, chatbox will tell "Perhaps I should have a look and see if Unferth's potatoes have grown...".
Use the logs on fireplace, then light the fireplace.
Use the chocolate cake and bucket of milk on the table.
Give Unferth a haircut. [Chat: 2 Cut Unferth's hair]

p: One of the chores Bob asks you to do while he is gone
Dressing up as a nurse and "curing" Unferth
Bob talking to the King Black Dragon.
R4ng3rno0b889 is killed by the King Black Dragon.

steps.t: Talk to Unferth once all the chores are done.
Talk to the Apothecary in south-west Varrock. [Chat: 1 Tell the Apothecary that Unferth is ill. › Any]
Unequip your weapons and equip the doctors hat/nurse hat and your white robes.
Return to Unferth with a vial of water.
Talk to Bob the cat. If he's not at his previous location, locate him again using the catspeak amulet (e).
After the cutscene, talk to Unferth again.
